title: LXMF RRC interop completeness gaps
body: LXMF/RRC completeness hunt. Gaps vs LXMF-ref 1.1.0 and rrcd/spec 0.1.3: RRC missing KeyDestination=8, TypeResourceEnvelope=50, WELCOME capabilities, opaque MSG body forwarding (Go rejects maps vs spec opaque), JOINED/PARTED presence notify to other members, direct NOTICE, legacy HELLO nick key 64. Interop tests missing many field/type round-trips and PN stamp. Duplicate Taskfile test:lxmf:interop.
